notes: Short local synthetic tests, no VM deployment. Other workloads varied on this PC.
Rust has no WS compression and coalesces live host counts every 250ms. Python baselines differ in both runtime and architecture.
All-stored includes local per-player think time and broadcast delivery spread, polling resolution ~50ms.
one-worker and zero-think have independent fixed-rate probes; earlier HTTP probes share the host controller loop.
CPU percentages are relative to one core, runtime only; Redis and proxy also share the same four server CPUs.
First 10000 four-threads run had one join retry and is excluded from clean capacity evidence.
